description: We are three siblings interested in learning about astronomy and science. We are beginners. This is our first challenge.
summary: We are using a Comic format as a means for Storytelling, in which we tell the story of the two Twin Rovers, Spirit and Opportunity, as pioneers in the research of Mars. We wish to give others the chance to learn about the importance of these Rovers in the planet's exploration, not to forget them.
details:
This is a small Comic for children ages 6 to 10 years. Our goal is to get young audiences interested in space exploration, science, and technology. Our team drew and colored all illustrations using Procreate®, and Canvas templates for editing the Comic book.

We prepared a short story for young children to get a full picture of the mission and the current condition of the Rovers.
dataRefs: Mars Exploration Rovers: Spirit and Opportunity
20 Years After Landing: How NASA’s Twin Rovers Changed Mars Science
